app.title: Alghali Street Admin
app.description: Manage shops, technicians, payments and bookings

common.errorBody: The database didn't answer as expected. Check the connection and try again.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that. Sign in again as an admin.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: That change isn't allowed from the shop's current status. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_SETTING: One of the values isn't valid.
errors.SYNONYMS_TOO_FEW: A group needs at least two different words.
errors.NO_VARIANTS: Those models have no engine variants yet.
errors.SAME_PART: Pick a different part to merge into.
errors.CANNOT_REVOKE_OWN_ADMIN: You can't remove your own admin access. Ask another admin.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password needs at least 8 characters, with letters and digits.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: The password service isn't set up on the server yet.
errors.NAME_REQUIRED: Every name needs both Arabic and English.
errors.INVALID_LOCATION: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
errors.ZONE_OUT_OF_RANGE: A zone must start before it ends and stay within the street's length.
errors.ZONE_HAS_SHOPS: A zone that still has shops can't be removed. Hide it instead.
errors.DUPLICATE_TXN: That transaction number was already used for another payment.
errors.TXN_REQUIRED: Type the transaction number from the statement first.
errors.INVALID_TXN: Enter the transaction number from Bankak, digits only.
errors.NOT_UNDER_REVIEW: This receipt was already handled. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.ALREADY_PAID: This was already recorded as sent.
errors.NOT_APPROVED: Approve the payout before recording it as paid.
errors.PERIOD_ALREADY_PAID: Payouts for this period were already prepared.
errors.PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND: This payout no longer exists or can't change.
errors.SUBORDER_NOT_FOUND: That part of the order no longer exists.

system.backendNotConfigured: Not set up yet — add the Supabase keys to .env

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Live numbers from the database
overview.queueFittings: Fittings waiting for a technician or a new time

activity.PASSWORD: {actor} set a temporary password for a user
activity.BOOKING_REASSIGNED: {actor} passed a fitting to another technician

payments.title: Bankak transfer confirmations
payments.subtitle: Match every receipt with the bank statement before confirming. A screenshot alone never counts as payment.
payments.receiptPlaceholder: The receipt as the buyer uploaded it
payments.checkRef: Order number is in the note
payments.checkStatement: Transfer appears on the Bankak statement
payments.tickStatement: Tick after checking the statement yourself
payments.confirmed: Payment confirmed; the buyer and shop were notified.
payments.rejected: Receipt rejected; the buyer was asked to send it again.
payments.selectHint: Pick a transfer from the list to review it.
payments.failedHint: Some checks failed. Reject the receipt so the buyer can fix it.
payments.statementAmount: A transfer of {amount} appears on the Bankak statement
payments.txnMissing: The buyer sent only a screenshot. Type the transaction number from the statement before confirming.
payments.refInNoteLabel: The order number is in the transfer note
payments.refInNoteHint: Optional. The transfer can still be matched by amount and transaction number.
payments.noReceipt: No screenshot: the buyer sent the transaction number only.
payments.refundsEmptyBody: When a shop declines a paid order, or a return is approved, the refund appears here.
payments.noRefundAccount: No refund account yet: call the buyer
payments.refundPaidBody: Send {amount} to {buyer} from the platform's Bankak account, then enter the transaction number.
payments.refundPaidToast: Refund recorded; the buyer was told.

approvals.title: Partner applications
approvals.subtitle: Review shops and technicians before buyers can see them.
approvals.approved: {shop} is live; buyers can see it now.
approvals.rejectBody: The owner sees this reason in the partner app and can apply again.
approvals.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the plot number doesn't match the trade licence
approvals.emptyBody: New shop applications from the partner app show up here.
approvals.techRejectBody: They see this reason in the partner app and can apply again.
approvals.techReasonPlaceholder: For example: please add the certificate from your workshop
approvals.emptyTechBody: New technician applications from the partner app show up here.

shops.title: Shops
shops.subtitle: Every shop on the street. Approve, suspend and verify from here.
shops.verifiedHint: Shows a verified badge to buyers
shops.suspendBody: Buyers stop seeing the shop and its stock until you reinstate it. The owner sees the reason.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every order on the platform.
orders.emptyBody: Orders appear here as soon as buyers check out.
orders.notAccepted: Not accepted by the shop yet
orders.cancelBody: The stock goes back to the shop. If the buyer has paid, a refund is created for you to send.
orders.cancelledToast: Cancelled; the buyer and the shop were told.
orders.completedToast: Marked completed; the shop's sale is recorded.
orders.returnRequested: The buyer asked to return this
orders.returnApprovedToast: Return approved; a refund is ready to send.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.subtitle: Fitting appointments at bays and at customers’ places.
bookings.emptyBody: Fittings appear here when buyers book a technician.
bookings.codeLocked: The job code locked after five wrong tries. Check with the buyer, then mark it completed.
bookings.cancelBody: The buyer gets back everything paid for it, and the parts bought for it are cancelled and refunded.
bookings.cancelledToast: Fitting cancelled; the buyer and the technician were told.
bookings.reassignedToast: Offered to the next free technician, or the buyer will be asked for a new time.
bookings.completedToast: Fitting completed; the technician’s pay is recorded.

cash.title: Cash reconciliation
cash.subtitle: Who owes whom: commission on cash shops kept, booking fees on cash technicians kept, and what the platform owes them. Flagged after two payout runs unpaid.
cash.emptyBody: Shops and technicians appear here once they work through the platform.
cash.collectedHint: Cash they took from buyers since their last payout.

payouts.title: Partner payouts
payouts.subtitle: What each shop and technician is owed after deductions and the cash they already kept, sent by Bankak.
payouts.markPaidBody: Send {amount} to {partner} from the platform's Bankak account, then enter the transaction number.
payouts.txnInvalid: Enter the transaction number from Bankak, digits only.
payouts.prepared: Payouts prepared for every shop and technician the platform owes.
payouts.noRunBody: Prepare payouts to see what each shop and technician is owed up to now.
payouts.nothingOwed: Nobody is owed money right now.
payouts.deductionsHint: Commission, booking fees, cash already kept, and balances carried over.
payouts.cancelledToast: Payout cancelled. The amount stays owed and joins the next payout.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.subtitle: Problems with an order or a fitting, raised by buyers, shops or technicians.
disputes.emptyBody: Complaints from the apps show up here.
disputes.pick: Pick a dispute to read it.
disputes.sentToast: Message sent; everyone involved was told.
disputes.decisionBody: Everyone involved sees this. Put money right with the order or fitting tools (cancel, return, refund).
disputes.decisionPlaceholder: For example: the shop replaced the part
disputes.resolvedToast: Dispute closed; everyone involved was told.

catalogue.title: Catalogue & fitment
catalogue.subtitle: Fitment data decides what buyers see as “Fits your car”.
catalogue.gapsBody: These parts show “Check fitment” to buyers. Parts that are listed for sale come first.
catalogue.fitmentTitle: Which cars does this part fit?
catalogue.fitmentBody: Pick the models. Every engine variant of each model is added.
catalogue.shopPartsBody: Parts shops created themselves. Accept one as it is, or merge it into the matching catalogue part.
catalogue.mergeBody: Its listings move to the part you choose and the duplicate is retired. This can't be undone here.
catalogue.mergeNoMatch: No catalogue parts in this category match
catalogue.synonymsBody: Words people use for the same part, including local names.
catalogue.synonymHint: Separate words with commas — at least two
catalogue.deleteBody: Searches stop treating these words as the same.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Platform values the apps read. Changes apply at once and are recorded in the audit log.
settings.bandsHint: Each band must reach further than the one before. Beyond the last band is not served.
settings.notSaved: Some settings weren't saved. Check the highlighted fields.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Every account on the platform. Give admin access, or set a temporary password for someone who called support.
users.countLimit: Showing the newest {n} — search to find others
users.name: Account
users.makeAdminBody: They can approve shops, change settings and manage every account, including other admins.
users.removeAdminBody: They are signed out of the console the next time they open a page.
users.setPasswordBody: Give it to them by phone or WhatsApp, and ask them to change it after signing in. Their old password stops working.
users.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with letters and digits.
users.emptyBody: Search by part of a name, an email, or a phone number like 0912…

street.title: Street & zones
street.subtitle: Where the market is and how the street is divided. Delivery and travel fees are measured from the street's starting point.
street.originHint: Paste a pin from Google Maps (for example 15.5007, 32.5599) or type the two numbers.
street.originMissing: Not set yet: travel and delivery fees can't be worked out until it is.
street.placeholderNames: Placeholder names — replace with the real ones
street.zonesBody: Stretches of the street, in metres from its start. Shops pick a zone when they apply.
street.strip: The street from start to end, with its zones and shops
street.none: No street is set up yet. Run the database migrations first.

login.title: Admin sign in
login.subtitle: For the platform operations team only
login.notAdmin: This account isn't an admin. Ask an admin to give you access.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.notConfigured: The backend isn't set up yet. Fill in .env and run pnpm dev again.
login.failed: Couldn't sign in. Check your connection and try again.
